The result: the best crypto card for Europe is no longer a hypothetical—it's a competitive, feature-rich field.

**Signal:** If you're in the UK, Germany, France, Spain, or any of 24 other European nations, non-custodial crypto cards are now the default for on-chain spenders. This wasn't true even 12 months ago.
